Knochen: Zentrierte Stellung im Kniegelenk. Zystenbildung an der Eminentia intercondylaris (5/20). Kein Bone Bruise. Grenzwertiger Insall-Salvati Index mit 1,4. Patella lateralisiert (Patella lateralisation index 7 mm). Keine Trochleadysplasie. Kein MR-morphologischer Frakturnachweis. Fabella. 
Knorpel: Streifige fokale Signalanhebung des retropatellaren Knorpels am Patellafirst (4/15). Fokal bis tiefgreifende Chondropathie der Trochlea (4/23). Keine wesentliche Chondropathie femorotibial. 
Menisci: Flaue Signalanhebung des Innenmeniskushinterhornes mit V.a. horizontale Rissbildung (6/8). Schräge Rissbildung des Außenmeniskusvorderhornes mit Austritt der Rissbildung an die tibiale Gelenkfläche (5/18). Intaktes Außenmeniskushinterhorn. 
Bänder/Sehnen/Kapsel/Gelenkraum: Intakte Darstellung des vorderen und hinteren Kreuzbandes. Mediales und laterales Kollateralband intakt. Bds. intakte menisceale Aufhängung. Gelenkkapsel nicht verdickt, kein wesentlicher Gelenkerguss. Keine freien intraartikulären Gelenkkörper. Patellarsehne und Quadricepssehne intakt. 
Weichteilmantel: Unauffällig.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 5 to 6 months of aching sharp constant pain at the front of the knee
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn and body with dominant horizontal oblique component. Mild extrusion and displacement into the meniscotibial recess.
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade cartilage thinning in the central weightbearing femoral condyle and reciprocal tibial surface.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal cartilage fissuring at the medial patellar facet adjacent to the median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complex tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with dominant horizontal oblique component. Mild extrusion and displacement into the meniscotibial recess.

2. Moderate medial compartment and minimal patellofemoral chondrosis.

3. Probable lateral patellofemoral maltracking with impingement of Hoffa's fat.

4. Small Baker's cyst.
